build.beforeDevCommand: npm run build --workspace @agent-audit/contracts && npm run dev --workspace @agent-audit/web -- --host 127.0.0.1
build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run build --workspace @agent-audit/contracts && npm run build --workspace @agent-audit/web

security.csp: default-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost http://127.0.0.1:*; img-src 'self' asset: data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:;

bundle.shortDescription: 企业知识助手业务权限安全验收与自动化红队系统
bundle.longDescription: 知盾 AgentAudit 面向小企业管理员的本机安全验收桌面软件。
